# Lorenzo Marchisio

> Personal site of Lorenzo Marchisio: engineer, founder and photographer, studying at Politecnico di Torino and moving from Cuneo, Italy, to Leuven, Belgium. It also presents his studio that builds websites for small businesses.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/): who Lorenzo is, as an engineer, a founder and a photographer, plus his journey from Cuneo to Leuven
- [Websites](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/websites/): fast, multilingual websites for small businesses anywhere in the world, at fixed prices
- [Website projects](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/websites/gallery/): websites built for small businesses
- [Photo gallery](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/gallery/): motorcycle, football and travel photographs from Slovenia and Croatia
- [CV](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/cv.pdf): curriculum vitae, PDF
